review_limits: No paper draft was supplied, so textual claims and interpretations in the draft could not be verified directly against the code (draft unavailable as noted in prompt instructions).

The full Stata pipeline (approx. 2.5 hours runtime) and 200 GB checksum verification were not run during this review pass; execution behavior was verified through code inspection, static parsing, path resolution, and manifested checksum set comparisons.
External raw census files and intermediate link datasets live outside the repository and could not be inspected directly for record-level content.
structured_output.summary: Commit 199f386 integrates Section 4.3 (Tables 9ΓÇô11) into Machine A's replication package and cleanly resolves all three findings from the prior review cycle. The PowerShell driver path formatting is corrected, all 285 newly added inputs are preflighted and registered in the 389-file SHA-256 manifest, and deletion detection for divided-file shards is implemented. The commit introduces no new defects across correctness, replication, claims-vs-code, or identification.

verified_clean.evidence: replication/Run-MachineA.ps1:56 now formats the path argument as literal 'MATCHING\fs_draft_tables.py' without form-feed characters, successfully resolving to an existing file and failing immediately if execution returns non-zero.

summary.description: Two to four sentences. The overall state of the reviewed work and the single most important thing to fix. No preamble.

dimensions_reviewed.description: Which scope dimensions were actually reviewed in this run.

findings.description: Defects and concerns, ordered most severe first. Empty if none. Do not pad with stylistic observations.

severity.description: blocker: a reported result is wrong. major: a referee would demand it. minor: real but survivable. nit: cosmetic.

confidence.description: verified: traced in the source. likely: strongly implied but depends on unseen data. speculative: a question, not an established defect.

title.description: One line, stating the defect itself, not its category.

location.description: path:line, or path:line-line. Several may be comma-separated. Required: a finding without a location is not a finding.

what_the_code_does.description: Precisely what the code computes, quoting the relevant expression. Contrast with what it was evidently intended to compute.

why_it_matters.description: The consequence for a number or claim in the paper. If there is no consequence, the severity is nit.

how_to_check.description: A concrete command, tabulation, or count the author can run to confirm or refute this in minutes.

suggested_fix.description: The change, specific enough to act on. Do not apply it yourself.

verified_clean.description: Things explicitly checked that were fine. This is what makes a short findings list trustworthy rather than lazy.

evidence.description: How it was confirmed, with path:line where applicable.

review_limits.description: What this review could NOT establish: data not readable, pipeline not runnable, paper text unavailable, Stata semantics not verifiable by reading. Be explicit; silence here reads as false assurance.
